title: Moving to Gelan Gura & Corridor Relocation Flats: First-Time Settling Guide
excerpt: Relocated to Gelan Gura, Ayat 49, or Bole Arabsa from inner Addis? Plan your first move-in, truck access, utilities, and long commutes with Active Movers.
content:
Who this guide is for

Thousands of households have moved into new flats on Addis Ababa’s outskirts—especially Gelan Gura, areas past Ayat, and Bole Arabsa—as part of corridor redevelopment from neighborhoods such as Kazanchis/Kirkos. Whether you received a relocation unit or bought into a new compound, your first professional move is about access, timing, and finishing the unit before furniture arrives.

Before the truck comes

  • Confirm which phase of your building is finished: doors, windows, power, water, and elevator status.
  • Walk the route from the gate to your door—note unpaved segments, stairs-only blocks, and where a truck can legally stop.
  • Book compound management for move-in day: security list, lift slot, and any deposit for common-area protection.
  • Prioritize one-trip essentials if you still commute to inner-city work—pack “first week” separately.

Distance and scheduling

Outskirt sites mean longer truck time from Bole, Piassa, or Kazanchis. Start early on a Saturday if allowed, and avoid stacking your move on the same day as school registration or document errands downtown.

Social and service reality

Residents often report longer trips to clinics, markets, and former neighbors while schools and shops catch up. Plan storage or a phased move if you are splitting time between old and new addresses during handover.

How Active Movers helps

We quote honestly for distance, carry, and condo paperwork—not just kilometers. Request a corridor relocation quote and read our condo checklist.

Pairing old and new addresses

Many families keep furniture in inner-city rentals while finishing Gelan or Arabsa units. A two-stop day (storage yard or relative’s garage, then new flat) needs written sequence and volume caps—see storage-between-homes guide. Truck timing rules still apply on corridor roads—freight timing.

Related area guides

Utility and handover week

Corridor flats sometimes receive keys before stable power or water. Confirm utilities before the truck loads heavy appliances; otherwise you pay twice for repositioning. Keep a first-night box at the old address until the new unit is livable.

Corridor pricing

Long truck runs from inner Kirkos or Kazanchis to Gelan add crew time—compare fixed quotes with traffic buffer—hourly vs fixed · avoid delala surprises · +251982260000

Commute reality

Many corridor residents still work downtown—schedule load on a day you can tolerate longer commutes from the old address if keys overlap both units for a week.

Handover checklist

Use the condo checklist for new corridor towers even when keys are brand new—management rules arrive before furniture.
